notes.title: 20240624 minor update
notes.content:
[2024/6/24]
- Add a settings window to the game scene.
- Add a setting to select whether or not to display damage numbers.
- Adjusted the display of special effects for ranged attacks.
- Fixed the bug that mage range attacks may be misjudged and cause double counting.
- Fix the bug that the exchange rate may not be displayed correctly when opening the market trading dialog.

notes.title: Come on, guys.
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Two days after the game's launch, the number of people playing at the same time finally broke 100 today, which is great to see! ːsteamthumbsupː
However, not many players have left reviews yet, so I'm going to ask you to do the same. If you really like this game, please take the time to leave a review for me, so that the game will have a chance to make it to the top of the charts and be seen by more people. Thank you all! The support of the players is my greatest motivation! ːsteamhappyː
